_doc: Thief first job (#167/#207). Rank equals canonical Skill.wz level; canonical requirements, counts, costs, damage and art are tier A. Survivor casting choices are labelled per entry. Canonical prerequisites are ignored (tier C owner choice #31). Binding skill keys: nimble_body, double_stab, lucky_seven; later tickets append their own entries.

nimble_body.name: Nimble Body
nimble_body.desc: Increases accuracy and avoidability. Accuracy also raises critical chance.

double_stab.name: Double Stab
double_stab.desc: Stabs one monster twice within your dagger's reach.
double_stab._tier: Tier A: WZ weapon 33, damage, attackCount 2, mpCon, stabO1 action and CharLevel hit art. Tier C: weapon_reach auto-cast, one base target, cooldown 1.2s, action hold 0.6s; untuned.

lucky_seven.name: Lucky Seven
lucky_seven.desc: Throws two stars at nearby monsters, using LUK regardless of Claw Mastery.
lucky_seven._tier: Tier A: WZ weapon 47, bulletCount 2, damage, mpCon, effect and CharLevel hit art; no ball node, so ammo_shot uses the current star. Tier B: LUK x5.0/x2.5 formula ignoring mastery (v83-facts 5). Tier C: nearest auto-cast, 250px base claw reach, cooldown 1s, shoot1 held 0.6s, speed 600px/s, radius 8px, no base pierce; untuned.

keen_eyes.name: Keen Eyes
keen_eyes.desc: Increases claw basic attack and skill range.
keen_eyes._tier: Tier A: eight canonical range levels, +25 to +200px. Tier C: claw family gate follows the v83 description; reuses #199's generic additive range passive.

text.desc: Increases claw basic attack and skill range.

disorder.name: Disorder
disorder.desc: Lowers nearby monsters' weapon attack and defence and interrupts their ongoing attacks.

text.desc: Lowers nearby monsters' weapon attack and weapon defence, interrupting their ongoing attacks. Monsters already threatened cannot be affected again.
text.h: MP -{mp_cost}; enemy weapon attack {x}, weapon def. {y} for {time} sec., up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}

disorder._tier: Tier A: canonical mpCon, signed x/y, time, mob art and Use sound; no weapon requirement, action or effect node. Tier C: Threaten crowd rule, at least 3 fresh ordinary mobs in a (-250,-150)..(250,150) box, nearest 6 targets, 1s cooldown and alert2 held 0.8s. Interrupt cancels a pending attack and its stance, preserving its existing wait; no stun. Initial survivor choices, untuned.

claw_mastery.name: Claw Mastery
claw_mastery._tier: Tier A: canonical levels and passive values. Tier C: weapon-family requirement, from the v83 skill description. Endless stars ignore recharge capacity.

text.desc: Increases claw mastery and accuracy while holding a claw.

critical_throw.name: Critical Throw
critical_throw.desc: Increases the critical chance and damage of claw attacks.
critical_throw._tier: Tier A: canonical levels and passive values. Tier C: weapon-family requirement, from the v83 skill description. Endless stars ignore recharge capacity.

dagger_mastery.name: Dagger Mastery
dagger_mastery._tier: Tier A: canonical levels and passive values. Tier C: weapon-family requirement, from the v83 skill description. Endless stars ignore recharge capacity.

claw_booster.name: Claw Booster
claw_booster.desc: Temporarily increases the attack speed of claws.
claw_booster._tier: Tier A: x=-2 scaled by -1 means two steps faster; canonical time, hpCon, mpCon, alert2, art and sound. Tier C: weapon-family requirement from the v83 description; self auto-cast while inactive, 0.8s hold.

haste_assassin.name: Haste
haste_assassin.desc: Temporarily increases your movement speed and jump height.
haste_assassin._tier: Tier A: canonical speed, jump, time, mpCon, alert2, art and sound. Tier C: self-only auto-cast while inactive with any weapon, 0.8s hold; existing movement caps apply.

text.desc: Temporarily increases your movement speed and jump height.

dagger_booster.name: Dagger Booster
dagger_booster.desc: Temporarily increases the attack speed of daggers.
dagger_booster._tier: Tier A: x=-2 scaled by -1 means two steps faster; canonical time, hpCon, mpCon, alert2, art and sound. Tier C: weapon-family requirement from the v83 description; self auto-cast while inactive, 0.8s hold.

haste_bandit.name: Haste
haste_bandit.desc: Temporarily increases your movement speed and jump height.
haste_bandit._tier: Tier A: canonical speed, jump, time, mpCon, alert2, art and sound. Tier C: self-only auto-cast while inactive with any weapon, 0.8s hold; existing movement caps apply.

text.desc: Temporarily increases your movement speed and jump height.

endure_assassin.name: Endure
endure_assassin.desc: Recovers additional HP and MP anywhere, on its own recovery clock.
endure_assassin._tier: Tier A: canonical hp, mp and time at all 20 levels. Owner #167: recovery anywhere with any weapon. Tier C: first pulse one interval after learning; rank changes retain elapsed time, round boundaries reset it.

text.desc: Recovers additional HP and MP anywhere, on its own recovery clock.
text.h: Recover +{hp} HP and +{mp} MP every {time} sec.

savage_blow.name: Savage Blow
savage_blow.desc: Strikes a monster up to six times with a dagger.
savage_blow._tier: Tier A: canonical weapon 33, attackCount, damage, mpCon, savage action, effect, hit art and sounds. Tier C: weapon_reach auto-cast, one base target, cooldown 1.2s, action hold 1.0s; untuned.

steal.name: Steal
steal.desc: A melee strike that can take one extra item from each monster, including bosses.
steal._tier: Tier A: canonical damage, mpCon, prop, swingO2 action, effect and sound; no weapon gate. Owner #167: retry until success, one extra loot per logical mob, bosses included. Tier C: range_around auto-cast within 100px, one base target, cooldown 1.2s, action hold 0.6s; extra loot uses ordinary equipment chance/pool, else a normal meso bundle; untuned.

text.desc: Strikes nearby monsters and tries to take an extra item. Each monster, including a boss, can be stolen from once; failed attempts can be retried.
text.h: MP -{mp_cost}; {damage}% damage, {prop}% chance to steal one extra item.
